eventName: On the occasion of Natural Resources Conservation Day, Tree plantation Activity.
eventDescription:
Vidhaigal Volunteer Organization, Golden Hearts Lions Club, and Alliance Club jointly planted native tree saplings such as Mahilam, Neem, Neermaruthu, and Mandharai at the Walajabad Sub-Registrar Office premises today.
Students of Arignar Anna Government Boys Higher Secondary School actively participated in the event by planting saplings and spreading awareness about the importance of protecting our natural resources.
